thread:
sara_sales: quick q — ACME POC asked if we can commit to a 48h vendor notification window for confirmed incidents and provide redacted runtime logs during the POC. they also asked whether hosted vs VPC changes that. need an answer before my call at 5pm :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex_security: short version: hosted = 72h formal notification in contract; 48h preliminary advisory is possible for a POC but it needs careful scoping + legal signoff. 48h formal binding notice typically requires Private/Dedicated + amended breach clause. clarify what they mean by "provide logs" (summary vs full payload).

jordan_engineer: technical note — for hosted we can export metadata + error traces quickly (request_id, timestamps, model_id, token counts, latency, error stack). we do NOT by default export full request payloads (user content) without additional approvals. retention defaults: 30 days; Dedicated/Private can extend retention and provide controlled access.

sam_cs: customer specifically asked for a "forensic bundle" during POC — their vendor risk team wants to see sample incident artifacts within 48h to sign off on the PoC. they said it can be redacted.

alex_security: recommended path: 1) Offer a POC-specific operational commitment: preliminary advisory within 48h after confirmation of compromise (high-level summary + redacted forensic bundle), 2) Formal legal breach notification per contract within 72h, 3) Require an NDA + limited-scope forensics access for the POC, 4) If they need a firm 48h contractual obligation, route them to Dedicated/Private and involve legal for SLA amendment.

sara_sales: can you drop a suggested clause we can hand to their legal?

alex_security: sure — paste below (draft):
```
POC Incident Advisory and Forensics Access. For the limited-duration proof-of-concept (POC) period, Vendor will provide a preliminary security advisory within 48 hours of Vendor confirmation of a security incident materially affecting Customer PII or Customer production workloads (Preliminary Advisory). The Preliminary Advisory will include a high-level timeline, impacted components, and a redacted forensic bundle limited to request identifiers, timestamps, model identifiers, token counts, request hashes, and sanitized error traces. Full payloads or user content will not be shared except where required by law or pursuant to a separate forensics agreement.

Formal breach notification obligations in the Parties' Master Agreement (including any 72-hour notification requirement) remain applicable and will follow the contract's notification process. The Parties will execute a mutual non-disclosure agreement addressing use and retention of forensic artifacts before any transfer of redacted logs.
```

jordan_engineer: implementation note — we can automate the redacted bundle export (scripted) and deliver via secure transfer (SFTP/secure share) within 48h of confirmation, provided security signs off and the NDA is executed. we need to flag any PII-sensitive fields for redaction; that'll cost small ops time.

sam_cs: sales: if they want the 48h contractual guarantee instead of a POC advisory we should price for Dedicated — we can enable 90d retention + SIEM integration and a tighter notification SLA. need to confirm delta with pricing team.

jen_legal: I will review the draft clause. likely feedback: change "will provide" to "will use commercially reasonable efforts to provide" for the binding clause, and define "confirmation" to avoid premature triggers. also confirm scope of "forensic bundle" to avoid over-sharing.

alex_security: noted. security is OK with the draft as a POC advisory. legal will need to confirm final wording for any binding 48h commitment. also: CAIQ/SIG mapping — IR-related controls (IR-01, IR-02) map to this flow; we can provide the SIG matrix if ACME asks.

sara_sales: perfect — i'll tell ACME: (a) we can do a 48h preliminary advisory + redacted bundle for the POC under NDA, (b) formal contractual breach notices follow 72h in the MA, and (c) if they need a contractual 48h guarantee we should move to Dedicated/VPC and involve legal. tagging for follow-ups: @alex_security for SIG pointer, @jordan_engineer for the export script ETA, @jen_legal for final clause tweak. :thumbsup:

alex_security: will post SIG mapping doc and a one-page IR summary in this thread by EOD.

jordan_engineer: i'll estimate ops time and add a short runbook for the export — ETA tomorrow morning.

jen_legal: i'll post suggested language tomorrow after internal review.

sara_sales: thanks everyone, i'll update ACME and loop back with quotes if they want Dedicated.
